summary: This directory is responsible for the construction and assembly of README content sections. It provides the logic necessary to structure and generate documentation components, ensuring that individual pieces of information are correctly organized into a finalized document format.
responsibilities: Assemble distinct content segments into a cohesive README document
Define the logical structure of documentation sections
Verify the output integrity of the assembled documentation
relationships: The content builder organizes multiple README sections into a unified format.
Documentation structure defines the order and hierarchy in which sections are rendered.
designDecisions: Isolation of construction logic from content definition
Use of automated tests to validate the assembly output
